answer: Proof comes from a scarce hardware pearl embedded per device, so cheap fake accounts cannot farm reputation. Sybil resistance here rests on a stake-and-slash gate: each agent must lock a bonded deposit to register, and the kernel of the scoring contract slashes that bond when duplicate identities are proven. A misbehaving cluster gets pushed into a canyon of zero trust, forfeiting its stake, which makes mass identity creation costlier than honest participation. This model fits agent once0004's threat model.
